metadata.question: Does the snow cover in northwestern Pennsylvania increase between February 22, 2020, and March 1, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need to analyze snow cover in northwestern Pennsylvania between Feb 22, 2020 and March 1, 2020. - Use MODIS snow cover data (MOD10A1 or MYD10A1) which provides daily snow cover - Northwestern Pennsylvania can be defined as a polygon around that region - Time periods: Feb 22, 2020 and March 1, 2020 2. Masking strategy: MODIS snow cover has quality flags, but for simplicity I'll use the NDSI snow cover band directly 3. Logic: Compare average snow cover percentage between the two dates - Calculate snow cover percentage for each date - Check if March 1 has higher snow cover than Feb 22 - Need to handle cases where data might be missing or heavily cloud-covered Let me define: - Collection: MODIS MOD10A1.006 Terra Snow Cover Daily - Bands: NDSI_Snow_Cover (snow cover percentage) - Location: Northwestern Pennsylvania polygon - Dates: Feb 22, 2020 and March 1, 2020 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const nwPennsylvania = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-80.5, 42.0], [-79.0, 42.0], [-79.0, 41.0], [-80.5, 41.0], [-80.5, 42.0]] ]); const date1 = '2020-02-22'; const date2 = '2020-03-01'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Snow Cover const modisSnow = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); const snowFeb22 = modisSnow.filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')); const snowMar1 = modisSnow.filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')); // Check collection sizes const countFeb22 = snowFeb22.size().getInfo(); const countMar1 = snowMar1.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 22 Images: ${countFeb22}, Mar 1 Images: ${countMar1}`); if (countFeb22 === 0 || countMar1 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get single images for each date const imgFeb22 = snowFeb22.first(); const imgMar1 = snowMar1.first(); // 3. Processing - Calculate snow cover percentage const scale = 1000; const statsFeb22 = imgFeb22.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: nwPennsylvania, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const statsMar1 = imgMar1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: nwPennsylvania, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanFeb22 = statsFeb22.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean').getInfo(); const countPixelsFeb22 = statsFeb22.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover_count').getInfo(); const meanMar1 = statsMar1.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean').getInfo(); const countPixelsMar1 = statsMar1.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 22: Snow Cover ${meanFeb22?.toFixed(2) || 'N/A'}%, Pixels: ${countPixelsFeb22}`); console.log(`Mar 1: Snow Cover ${meanMar1?.toFixed(2) || 'N/A'}%, Pixels: ${countPixelsMar1}`); // Check for valid pixels if (countPixelsFeb22 === 0 || countPixelsMar1 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (meanFeb22 === null || meanMar1 === null || isNaN(meanFeb22) || isNaN(meanMar1) || meanFeb22 < 0 || meanFeb22 > 100 || meanMar1 < 0 || meanMar1 > 100) { console.log("C3"); return; } // 4. Final comparison console.log(`Snow cover change: ${(meanMar1 - meanFeb22).toFixed(2)}%`); if (meanMar1 > meanFeb22) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
